romantic-retreat.label: The Relaxed Retreat
romantic-retreat.resort: Desire Pearl may be worth exploring
romantic-retreat.primaryTrigger: Your answers point toward a vacation where downtime, privacy, and an unhurried pace matter most. Pearl is one option to compare against those priorities.
romantic-retreat.recommendedWing: Start by comparing the current room categories and locations at Pearl, with particular attention to how close each option is to areas you want to use.
romantic-retreat.bestFor: Couples who value quiet time together and want the freedom to join the social scene selectively.

balanced-explorer.label: The Flexible Explorer
balanced-explorer.primaryTrigger: Your answers suggest you want options: relaxing when you want to, joining the social scene when it appeals, and keeping your schedule flexible.
balanced-explorer.recommendedWing: Compare room locations at both resorts based on the areas you expect to use most, rather than choosing a room category from the quiz alone.
balanced-explorer.bestFor: Couples who want a mix of downtime, social opportunities, and flexibility from day to day.

social-celebration.label: The Social Explorer
social-celebration.resort: Desire Riviera Maya may be worth exploring
social-celebration.primaryTrigger: Your answers point toward a vacation where social activity, entertainment, and meeting other couples are important parts of the experience. Riviera Maya is one option to compare against those priorities.
social-celebration.recommendedWing: Start by comparing the current room categories and locations at Riviera Maya, especially the proximity of each option to the areas you expect to use most.
social-celebration.bestFor: Couples who enjoy being close to activity and want social opportunities to be a significant part of the trip.
